headings: Health Care Benefits Products and Services
Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness Products and Services
paragraphs: CVS Health Corporation, together with its subsidiaries (collectively, "CVS Health," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us"), is a leading health solutions company building a world of health around every consumer it serves and connecting care so that it works for people wherever they are. As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 9,000 retail locations, more than 1,000 walk-in and primary care medical clinics and a leading pharmacy benefits manager with approximately 87 million plan members and expanding specialty pharmacy solutions. We serve an estimated more than 37 million people through traditional, voluntary and consumer-directed health insurance products and related services, including expanding Medicare Advantage offerings and a leading standalone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan ("PDP"). We are creating new sources of value through our integrated model allowing us to expand into personalized, technology driven care delivery and health services, increasing access to quality care, delivering better health outcomes and lowering overall health care costs.
The Company has four reportable segments: Health Care Benefits, Health Services, Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness and Corporate/Other.

Our ambition at CVS Health is to be America's most trusted health care company. Our purpose is to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Across our unique collection of businesses, our work is rooted in our values: we care, we innovate with purpose, we are accountable and we prioritize safety and quality. Our strategy is focused on simplifying health care experiences, improving engagement, lowering costs and delivering better health outcomes. We expect to create sustainable shareholder value by delivering best-in-class execution, transforming consumer experiences, being the partner of choice and harnessing enterprise capabilities, enabled by innovation and capital stewardship.

The Health Care Benefits segment operates as one of the nation's leading diversified health care benefits providers through its Aetna® operations, serving an estimated more than 37 million people as of December 31, 2025. The Health Care Benefits segment has the information and resources to help members, in consultation with their health care professionals, make more informed decisions about their health care. The Health Care Benefits segment offers a broad range of traditional, voluntary and consumer-directed health insurance products and related services, including medical, pharmacy, dental and behavioral health plans, medical management capabilities, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, PDPs and Medicaid health care management services. The Health Care Benefits segment's primary customers, its members, primarily access the segment's products and services through employer groups, government-sponsored plans or individually. The Health Care Benefits segment also serves customers who purchase products and services that are ancillary to its health insurance products.

The Company refers to insurance products (where it assumes all or a majority of the risk for medical and dental care costs) as "Insured" and administrative services contract products (where the plan sponsor assumes all or a majority of the risk of medical and dental care costs) as "ASC." Health Care Benefits segment products and services consist of the following:

•Commercial Medical: The Health Care Benefits segment offers point-of-service ("POS"), preferred provider organization ("PPO"), health maintenance organization ("HMO") and indemnity benefit ("Indemnity") plans. Commercial medical products also include health savings accounts ("HSAs") and consumer-directed health plans that combine traditional POS or PPO and/or dental coverage, subject to a deductible, with an accumulating benefit account (which may be funded by the plan sponsor and/or the member in the case of HSAs). Principal products and services are targeted specifically to large multi-site national, mid-sized and small employers, individual insureds and expatriates. The Company offers medical stop loss insurance coverage for certain employers who elect to self-insure their health benefits. Under medical stop loss insurance products, the Company assumes risk for costs associated with large individual claims and/or aggregate loss experience within an employer's plan above a pre-set annual threshold. The segment also has a portfolio of additional health products and services that complement its medical products such as dental plans, behavioral health and employee assistance products, provider network access and vision products. The Company also sold Insured plans directly to individual consumers through the individual public health insurance exchanges ("Public Exchanges") through the year
ended December 31, 2025. The Company exited the states in which Aetna operated on the Public Exchanges effective January 2026.

•Government Medical: In select geographies, the Health Care Benefits segment offers Medicare Advantage plans, Medicare Supplement plans and prescription drug coverage for Medicare beneficiaries; participates in Medicaid and subsidized Children's Health Insurance Programs ("CHIP"); and participates in demonstration projects for members who are eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid ("Duals"). These Government Medical products are further described below:

•Medicare Advantage: Through annual contracts with the U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services ("CMS"), the Company offers HMO and PPO products for eligible individuals in certain geographic areas through the Medicare Advantage program. Members typically receive enhanced benefits over traditional fee-for-service Medicare coverage ("Original Medicare"), including reduced cost-sharing for preventive care, vision and other services. The Company offered network-based HMO and/or PPO plans in 44 states and Washington, D.C. in 2025. For certain qualifying employer groups, the Company offers Medicare PPO products nationally. When combined with the Company's PDP product, these national PPO plans form an integrated national Insured Medicare product for employers that provides medical and pharmacy benefits.

•Medicare PDP: The Company is a national provider of drug benefits under the Medicare Part D prescription drug program. All Medicare eligible individuals are eligible to participate in this voluntary prescription drug plan. Members typically receive coverage for certain prescription drugs, usually subject to a deductible, co-insurance and/or co-payment. The Company offered PDP plans in all 50 states and Washington, D.C. in 2025.

•Medicare Supplement: For certain Medicare eligible members, the Company offers supplemental coverage for certain health care costs not covered by Original Medicare. The products included in the Medicare Supplement portfolio help to cover some of the gaps in Original Medicare, and include coverage for Medicare deductibles and coinsurance amounts. The Company offered a wide selection of Medicare Supplement products in 49 states and Washington, D.C. in 2025.

•Medicaid and CHIP: The Company offers health care management services to individuals eligible for Medicaid and CHIP under multi-year contracts with government agencies in various states that are subject to annual appropriations. CHIP are state-subsidized insurance programs that provide benefits for families with uninsured children. The Company offered these services on an Insured or ASC basis in 15 states in 2025.

•Duals: The Company provides health coverage to beneficiaries who are dually eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid coverage. These members must meet certain income and resource requirements in order to qualify for this coverage. The Company coordinates 100% of the care for these members and may provide them with additional services in order to manage their health care costs.

The Company also has a portfolio of transformative products and services aimed at creating a holistic and integrated approach to individual health and wellness. These products and services complement the Commercial Medical and Government Medical products and aim to provide innovative solutions, create integrated experience offerings and enable enhanced care delivery to customers.

•We may not be able to accurately forecast health care and other benefit costs.

The Company has four reportable segments: Health Care Benefits, Health Services, Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness and Corporate/Other, which are described below.

The Health Care Benefits segment operates as one of the nation's leading diversified health care benefits providers through its Aetna® operations. The Health Care Benefits segment has the information and resources to help members, in consultation with their health care professionals, make more informed decisions about their health care. The Health Care Benefits segment offers a broad range of traditional, voluntary and consumer-directed health insurance products and related services, including medical, pharmacy, dental and behavioral health plans, medical management capabilities, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, PDPs and Medicaid health care management services. The Health Care Benefits segment's primary customers, its members, primarily access the segment's products and services through employer groups, government-sponsored plans or individually. The Health Care Benefits segment also serves customers who purchase products and services that are ancillary to its health insurance products. The Company refers to insurance products (where it assumes all or a majority of the risk for medical and dental care costs) as "Insured" and administrative services contract products (where the plan sponsor assumes all or a majority of the risk for medical and dental care costs) as "ASC." The Company also sold Insured plans directly to individual consumers through the individual public health insurance exchanges ("Public Exchanges") through the year ended December 31, 2025. The Company exited the states in which Aetna operated on the Public Exchanges effective January 2026.

The Health Services segment provides a full range of pharmacy benefit management ("PBM") solutions through its CVS Caremark® operations and delivers health care services in its medical clinics, virtually, and in the home. PBM solutions include plan design offerings and administration, formulary management, retail pharmacy network management services, and specialty and mail order pharmacy services. In addition, the Company provides clinical services, disease management services, medical spend management and pharmacy and/or other administrative services for providers and federal 340B drug pricing program covered entities ("Covered Entities"). The Company operates a group purchasing organization that negotiates pricing for the purchase of pharmaceuticals and rebates with pharmaceutical manufacturers on behalf of its participants and provides various administrative, management and reporting services to pharmaceutical manufacturers. The segment also works directly with pharmaceutical manufacturers to commercialize and/or co-produce high quality biosimilar products through its CordavisTM subsidiary. The Health Services segment's health care delivery assets include Signify Health, Inc. ("Signify Health"), a leader in health risk assessments and value-based care, and Oak Street Health, Inc. ("Oak Street Health"), a leading multi-payor operator of value-based primary care centers serving Medicare eligible patients. The Health Services segment's clients and customers are primarily employers, insurance companies, unions, government employee groups, health plans, PDPs, Medicaid managed care plans, the U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services ("CMS"), plans offered on public and private health insurance exchanges and other sponsors of health benefit plans throughout the U.S., patients who receive care in the Health Services segment's medical clinics, virtually or in the home, as well as Covered Entities.

The Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment dispenses prescriptions in its CVS Pharmacy® retail locations and through its infusion operations, provides ancillary pharmacy services including pharmacy patient care programs and vaccination administration, and sells a wide assortment of health and wellness products and general merchandise. The segment also provides pharmacy fulfillment services to support the Health Services segment's specialty and mail order pharmacy offerings. As of December 31, 2025, the Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment operated approximately 9,000 retail locations, as well as online retail pharmacy websites, retail specialty pharmacy stores, compounding pharmacies and branches for infusion and enteral nutrition services.
The Company presents the remainder of its financial results in the Corporate/Other segment, which primarily consists of:

•Management and administrative expenses to support the Company's overall operations, which include certain aspects of executive management and the corporate relations, legal, compliance, human resources and finance departments, information technology, digital, data and analytics, as well as acquisition-related transaction and integration costs; and
•Products for which the Company no longer solicits or accepts new customers such as its large case pensions and long-term care insurance products.

headings: 藥局與消費者健康應報告分部
藥局與消費者健康產品及服務
paragraphs: CVS Health Corporation, together with its subsidiaries (collectively, "CVS Health," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us"), 是一家領先的健康解決方案公司，透過為其服務的每一個消費者打造一個健康的環境，並連接照護，使其在任何地方都能為人們所用。截至2025年12月31日，我們擁有約9,000家零售門店，超過1,000家門診及主要照護醫療診所，以及一家領先的藥物福利管理公司，擁有約8700萬名計畫成員，並擴展專門藥物服務方案。我們透過傳統、自願及消費者導向的健康保險產品及相關服務，服務約3700萬人，包括擴展的醫療保險優勢方案及領先的獨立醫療保險Part D處方藥計畫（"PDP"）。我們透過整合模式創造新的價值來源，使我們能夠拓展至個人化、以科技驅動的照護交付及健康服務，提高對優質照護的可近性，提供更好的健康結果，並降低整體醫療成本。
本公司有四個應報告分部：健康照護福利、健康服務、藥物與消費者健康及企業/其他。

我們在CVS Health的願景是成為美國最受信賴的醫療公司。我們的宗旨是透過個人、家庭及社區，簡化醫療照護。在我們獨特的業務組閤中，我們的工作根植於我們的價值觀：我們關心、我們以有意義的方式創新、我們負責任，並優先考量安全與品質。我們的策略聚焦於簡化醫療照護體驗、提高參與度、降低成本，並提供更好的健康結果。我們預期透過提供最佳執行表現、轉變消費者體驗、成為首選合作夥伴，並善用企業能力，來創造可持續的股東價值，這些皆透過創新與資本管理所支撐。

健康照護福利分部透過其Aetna®業務運作，作為美國領先的多元化健康照護福利提供者，截至2025年12月31日，服務約3700萬人。健康照護福利分部擁有資訊與資源，協助成員在與其醫療專業人員諮詢後，做出更明智的醫療照護決策。健康照護福利分部提供廣泛的傳統、自願及消費者導向的健康保險產品及相關服務，包括醫療、藥物、牙科及行為健康計畫、醫療管理能力、醫療保險優勢計畫與醫療保險補充計畫、PDP及醫療保險管理服務。健康照護福利分部的主要客戶，即其成員，主要透過僱主團體、政府計畫或個人方式使用該分部的產品與服務。健康照護福利分部也服務那些購買與其健康保險產品相關的附加產品與服務的客戶。
本公司將保險產品（其中本公司承擔全部或主要風險以支付醫療及牙科費用）稱為"Insured"，並將行政服務契約產品（其中計畫贊助人承擔全部或主要風險以支付醫療及牙科費用）稱為"ASC"。醫療福利業務分部的產品與服務包含以下內容：

•商業醫療：醫療福利業務分部提供點數服務（"POS"）、優先供應商組織（"PPO"）、健康維護組織（"HMO"）及賠償福利（"Indemnity"）計畫。商業醫療產品亦包含健康儲蓄帳戶（"HSAs"）及結合傳統POS或PPO及/或牙科覆蓋（需符合免賠額）與累積福利帳戶的消費者導向醫療計畫（該帳戶可能由計畫贊助人及/或會員資助，於HSAs的情況下）。主要產品與服務專門針對大型多據點全國性、中型及小型僱主、個人被保險人及外僑。本公司為部分選擇自負風險其健康福利的僱主提供醫療停損保險覆蓋。於醫療停損保險產品下，本公司承擔與大型個人賠償及/或僱主計畫內超過預設年度門檻的總體損失經驗相關的成本風險。該分部亦擁有補充其醫療產品的其他醫療產品與服務組合，例如牙科計畫、行為健康及員工輔導產品、供應商網路存取及視力產品。本公司亦於該年度透過個人公共健康保險交易所（"Public Exchanges"）直接向個人消費者銷售Insured計畫
於 2025 年 12 月 31 日結束。本公司已退出 Aetna 在公開交易所運作的州份，自 2026 年 1 月起生效。
•政府醫療：在部分地區，醫療福利業務部門提供 Medicare Advantage 計畫、Medicare Supplement 計畫及處方藥覆蓋服務，供 Medicare 受保人使用；參與 Medicaid 計畫及補貼兒童健康保險計畫（"CHIP"）；並參與針對同時符合 Medicare 與 Medicaid 資格的會員（"Duals"）的示範計畫。這些政府醫療產品進一步說明如下：

•Medicare Advantage: 透過每年與美國醫療保險與醫療援助中心（"CMS"）簽訂的契約，本公司提供HMO與PPO產品，供符合資格的個別民眾在特定地理區域透過Medicare Advantage方案使用。會員通常可獲得較傳統費用服務醫療保險（"Original Medicare"）更高的福利，包括預防性照護、視力及其他服務的費用分擔減少。本公司於2025年在44個州及華盛頓特區提供基於網路的HMO與/或PPO方案。對於某些符合資格的僱主團體，本公司提供全國性的Medicare PPO產品。當與本公司PDP產品結合時，這些全國性PPO方案形成一個整合的全國性投保Medicare產品，為僱主提供醫療與藥物福利。
•Medicare PDP: 本公司是Medicare Part D處方藥計劃下的全國性藥物福利提供者。所有符合Medicare資格的個別民眾均有資格參與此自願處方藥計劃。會員通常可獲得某些處方藥的覆蓋，通常需符合免賠額、共付額及/或共付金。本公司於2025年在所有50個州及華盛頓特區提供PDP方案。

•Medicare Supplement: 對於某些符合Medicare資格的會員，本公司提供補充覆蓋，用以覆蓋Original Medicare未涵蓋的某些醫療費用。包含在Medicare Supplement產品組閤中的產品協助覆蓋Original Medicare的某些缺口，並包含覆蓋Medicare免賠額及共付金金額。本公司於2025年在49個州及華盛頓特區提供廣泛的Medicare Supplement產品。
•Medicaid和CHIP: 本公司為符合Medicaid及CHIP資格的個人提供醫療管理服務，透過與各州政府機構簽訂的多年契約，這些契約需每年經預算撥款。CHIP是州政府補助的保險計劃，為無保險兒童的家庭提供福利。本公司於2025年在15個州以投保或ASC方式提供這些服務。
•Duals: 本公司為同時符合Medicare與Medicaid資格的受益人提供醫療覆蓋。這些會員必須符合特定收入與資產條件，才能資格獲得此覆蓋。本公司為這些會員協調100%的照護，並可能為他們提供額外服務，以管理其醫療費用。
本公司亦擁有具創新性的產品與服務組合，旨在創造整體且整合的個人健康與 wellness 方案。這些產品與服務補足商業醫療與政府醫療產品，並致力於提供創新解決方案、創造整合體驗方案，並提升對客戶的照護交付。

paragraphs: CVS Health Corporation, together with its subsidiaries (collectively, "CVS Health," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us"), 是一家領導的健康解決方案公司，建立一個圍繞每一個消費者所服務的健康世界，並連接照護，使其在人們所在之處都能運作。截至2025年12月31日，本公司擁有約9,000個零售據點，超過1,000個門診及主要照護醫療診所，並擁有領導地位的藥物福利管理公司，擁有約8700萬名計畫成員，並擴展專門藥物服務方案。本公司也透過傳統、自願及消費者導向的健康保險產品及相關服務，服務約3700萬人，包括擴展的醫療保險優勢方案及領導地位的獨立醫療保險Part D處方藥計畫（"PDP"）。本公司透過其整合模式創造新的價值來源，使其能擴展至個人化、以科技驅動的照護交付及健康服務，增加對優質照護的接觸，提供更好的健康結果，並降低整體醫療成本。
本公司有四個應報告分部：健康照護福利、健康服務、藥物與消費者健康及企業/其他，以下為說明。

健康照護福利分部透過其Aetna®業務運作，為美國領先的多元化健康照護福利提供者之一。健康照護福利分部擁有資訊與資源，協助成員與其醫療專業人員協商，做出更明智的健康照護決策。健康照護福利分部提供廣泛的傳統、自願及消費者導向的健康保險產品及相關服務，包括醫療、藥物、牙科及行為健康計畫、醫療管理能力、醫療保險優勢與醫療保險補充計畫、PDPs及醫療保險管理服務。健康照護福利分部的主要客戶，即其成員，主要透過僱主團體、政府支持計畫或個人方式使用該分部的產品與服務。健康照護福利分部也服務購買與其健康保險產品相關的產品與服務的客戶。本公司將其承擔所有或主要風險的醫療與牙科費用的保險產品稱為"Insured"，將其計畫贊助人承擔所有或主要風險的醫療與牙科費用的行政服務合約產品稱為"ASC"。本公司也透過個人公共健康保險交易所（"Public Exchanges"）直接向個人消費者銷售Insured計畫，截至2025年12月31日。本公司已退出Aetna在Public Exchanges運作的州份，自2026年1月起生效。

健康服務分部透過其CVS Caremark®業務提供完整的藥物福利管理（"PBM"）解決方案，並在醫療診所、虛擬環境及居家提供健康照護服務。PBM解決方案包括計畫設計與行政服務、藥物清單管理、零售藥物網路管理服務，以及專門藥物與郵遞藥物服務。此外，本公司提供臨牀服務、疾病管理服務、醫療費用管理及藥物及其他行政服務給提供者及聯邦340B藥物價格計畫覆蓋機構（"Covered Entities"）。本公司運作一個集購組織，為其參與者與藥物製造商協商藥物購入價格與回扣，並為藥物製造商提供各種行政、管理與報告服務。該分部也與藥物製造商直接合作，透過其CordavisTM子公司進行高品質生物類似藥物的商業化與/或共同生產。健康服務分部的健康照護交付資產包括Signify Health, Inc.（"Signify Health"），為健康風險評估與價值導向照護的領導者，以及Oak Street Health, Inc.（"Oak Street Health"），為服務符合醫療保險資格患者的價值導向主要照護中心的領導多付費者運營商。健康服務分部的客戶與客戶主要為僱主、保險公司、工會、政府僱員團體、健康計畫、PDPs、醫療保險管理計畫、美國醫療保險與醫療援助服務中心（"CMS"）、公共與私人健康保險交易所提供的計畫，以及其他美國健康福利計畫的贊助者，接受健康服務分部醫療診所、虛擬環境或居家照護的患者，以及Covered Entities。

藥物與消費者健康分部在其CVS Pharmacy®零售據點處方藥，透過其輸液業務提供輔助藥物服務，包括藥物患者照護計畫與疫苗接種服務，並銷售廣泛的健康與 wellness 產品及一般商品。該分部也提供藥物履行服務，以支援健康服務分部的專門藥物與郵遞藥物服務。截至2025年12月31日，藥物與消費者健康分部運作約9,000個零售據點，以及網際網路零售藥物網站、零售專門藥物商店、製劑藥物商店及輸液與腸道營養服務分店。
本公司將其餘財務結果列示於企業/其他分部，該分部主要包含：
•支持本公司整體運作的管理與行政費用，包括部分高階管理及企業關係、法律、合規、人力資源及財務部門、資訊科技、數位、數據與分析，以及與併購相關的交易與整合費用；以及
•本公司不再招募能或接受新客戶的產品，例如其大型個案退休金與長期照護保險產品。

paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱下列風險與不確定性，以及本 10-K 中所載的其他資訊。這些風險與不確定性及其他因素可能影響我們的預測性陳述，包括我們在本 10-K 或其他地方所做出的預測性陳述，例如新聞稿、投資者或分析師電話會議、會議或簡報、網站或透過社交媒體頻道。上述風險與不確定性並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。我們無法保證已識別所有影響我們的風險。此外，目前未知或我們認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性，也可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。任何這些風險或不確定性都可能導致我們的實際結果與預期結果或預測性陳述中所討論的結果有重大差異。您不應以過往結果作為未來表現的指標。
若上述任何風險或不確定性發展為實際事件，或若風險或不確定性中所描述的情況發生或持續發生，這些事件或情況可能對我們的業務、營運結果、現金流、財務狀況及/或股票價格產生重大不利影響，以及其他對我們的影響。您應配合本 10-K 中的 MD&A（管理討論與分析）部分、本 10-K 第 7 項所載的合併財務報表及相關附註，以及本 10-K 中的「預測性陳述警示聲明」一併閱讀。
